name: Aripiprazole
summary: Aripiprazole is an atypical antipsychotic with partial agonist activity at dopamine D2 receptors.
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Hepatic CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 mediate dehydrogenation and hydroxylation; CYP3A4 also mediates N-dealkylation. Dehydro-aripiprazole is active. Drug-related material is eliminated in feces and urine.
